Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure. Program Overview Provide experienced analysts that will deliver network and exploitation analysis to secure and defend vital networks, and accelerate the nation's ability to meet the challenges posed by an increasingly complex global security environment. About The Role Computer Network Defense Analyst (LCAT: CNDA2) Location: Ft. Meade / Annapolis Junction, Maryland Clearance: Active TS/SCI with Polygraph Required Protect our nation's critical networks. Peraton's Cyber Mission business unit provides the Intelligence Community with mission-essential SIGINT and Cyber expertise. Join a team of elite professionals developing next-generation cybersecurity solutions that safeguard national security. What You'll Do As a Computer Network Defense Analyst, you will apply advanced analytical and technical skills to defend, monitor, and secure national networks. Responsibilities may include: Detect, analyze, and respond to cyber threats using data from intrusion detection systems, firewalls, network traffic logs, and host system logs. Develop and implement mitigations to strengthen network defenses and prevent attacks on network infrastructure devices or systems. Support multiple data transport environments, including wired networks, wireless (Wi-Fi/cellular), collaborative platforms, and related hardware/software. Build expertise in networking protocols, architectures, cloud security, IoT protocols, and advanced network defense techniques. Collaborate with government, military, and contractor personnel to align intelligence priorities, mission needs, and technical expertise. Apply analytical methods to form hypotheses, assess and select techniques, query and enrich data, and pivot as needed to provide actionable insights. Document, contextualize, and communicate findings-including newly developed tradecraft-to teammates, stakeholders, and intelligence consumers. #NextGenFF #AJCM #MDFSP Qualifications What You Bring Experience: 7+ years with an Associate's degree, OR 5+ years with a Bachelor's degree, OR 3+ years with a Master's degree, OR 1+ year with a PhD Relevant experience includes computer/information systems design, software/hardware engineering, network security, vulnerability analysis, penetration testing, digital forensics, information assurance, or systems engineering. Ability to conduct computer/network security assessments and target development. Experience developing new tradecraft to meet evolving mission challenges. Build and maintain strong relationships with key channel partners and distribution contacts leveraging existing networks from day one to accelerate pipeline. Educate and enable ecosystem partners on Netwrix's value proposition, competitive advantages, and sales motions. Cross-Functional Teamwork Partner with pre-sales engineers to develop compelling technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept engagements, and solution architectures tailored to customer environments. Collaborate with marketing on demand generation, regional events, and account-based marketing campaigns to accelerate pipeline creation. Work closely with customer success to ensure smooth onboarding, solution adoption, and a clear path to renewal and expansion from the first deal. Communicate pipeline status, forecast accuracy, risks, and key deal milestones clearly and consistently to sales leadership via Salesforce. Effectively position Netwrix's strengths in identity security, data access governance, Active Directory auditing, DLP, and DSPM against competing solutions. Qualifications Required Based in Dubai / UAE with full eligibility to work in the region. 10–12 years of enterprise software sales experience working directly for a software vendor (cybersecurity, IT security, or enterprise software). Expert-level ability to manage and close complex, long-cycle enterprise deals with multiple internal and external stakeholders. Strong existing network across the MEA enterprise IT and cybersecurity ecosystem – including distributors, VARs, MSSPs, and system integrators in the UAE and GCC. Deep understanding of cybersecurity concepts relevant to Netwrix's portfolio: Active Directory security, identity governance, privileged access management, data access governance, auditing and monitoring, DLP, and DSPM. Exceptional communication, executive presence, and negotiation skills – comfortable and credible at C-suite level. Fluency in both English and Arabic is mandatory. Willingness and ability to travel across the MEA region as required. Preferred Experience selling cybersecurity software solutions in regulated industries: financial services, government, energy, critical infrastructure, or healthcare. Familiarity with subscription-based, SaaS, or hybrid licensing models and the ability to position TCO/ROI effectively. Experience working in a high-growth B2B SaaS or cybersecurity software company with a fast-moving, target-driven culture. Existing senior relationships with CISOs, CIOs, and security leadership in UAE and GCC enterprises or government entities. review_candidates.description: Position Description At CGI, we deliver the secure, mission-critical systems that power the UK’s most vital sectors, helping to safeguard national interests while driving innovation and transformation. As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will play a central role in designing, deploying, and supporting complex platforms that combine on-premises and cloud environments. This is an opportunity to apply your expertise in Kubernetes, automation, and cloud-native technologies to deliver solutions that are critical to the nation, while working in a culture that values creativity, ownership, and collaboration. CGI was recognised in the Sunday Times Best Places to Work List 2025 and has been named a UK ‘Best Employer’ by the Financial Times. We offer a competitive salary, excellent pension, private healthcare, plus a share scheme (3.5% + 3.5% matching) which makes you a CGI Partner not just an employee. We are committed to inclusivity, building a genuinely diverse community of tech talent and inspiring everyone to pursue careers in our sector, including our Armed Forces, and are proud to hold a Gold Award in recognition of our support of the Armed Forces Corporate Covenant. Join us and you’ll be part of an open, friendly community of experts. We’ll train and support you in taking your career wherever you want it to go. Due to the secure nature of the programme, you will need to hold UK Security Clearance or be eligible to go through this clearance. This position is available in Gloucester and London. Your future duties and responsibilities In this role, you will take responsibility for designing, building, testing, and supporting infrastructure across hybrid environments, combining on-premises and cloud platforms. You will contribute to creating secure, scalable, and automated solutions using containerisation, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud-native tooling. You will collaborate with stakeholders across multiple sites, working as part of an agile team to troubleshoot complex issues, optimise performance, and introduce new capabilities. Your role will directly support critical national security systems, where reliability, compliance, and innovation are essential. Key responsibilities include: Design & Deploy: Build and manage infrastructure solutions across on-premises and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Innovate & Automate: Implement Kubernetes-based platforms, containerisation, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation). Secure & Govern: Apply infrastructure security, compliance, and governance best practices. Troubleshoot & Resolve: Analyse and solve complex infrastructure issues with a problem-solving mindset. Monitor & Optimise: Use monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK. Collaborate & Deliver: Work across diverse stakeholders and agile teams to drive continuous improvement. Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role You should have at least three years’ experience in infrastructure engineering, with a track record of delivering solutions across hybrid and cloud environments. Strong technical expertise combined with effective communication and collaboration skills will be key to your success. You should have experience in: Designing, building, deploying, testing, and supporting infrastructure solutions Deployment across on-premises and cloud environments (AWS preferred, Azure/GCP desirable) Kubernetes architecture (pods, services, deployments, networking) and containerisation (Docker) Platform engineering and familiarity with CNCF ecosystem Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation GitOps tooling such as Argo CD Scripting (Python, Shell) Container orchestration tools (e.g., Docker Swarm, Apache Mesos) Service Mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd) Monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) Applying infrastructure security, compliance, and governance practices Working within agile teams and using version control tools such as Git Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because… You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction. Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise. You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons. Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.
